show.description: A breakthrough cancer cure turns into a dangerous secret when scientist Aarohi Hegde becomes the target of powerful enemies. As threats close in, a mysterious protector enters her life, uncovering hidden pasts, power struggles, and deadly conspiracies. In a world ruled by control and greed, survival comes at a cost.
